title: BUG: unsigned underflow in PIV response parser when resplen<2
description: wp11_piv_sign() checks (resplen - 2u) < 2u before subtracting 2 from a size_t. If a CCID transport delivers resplen=1, the subtraction wraps to SIZE_MAX-1 and subsequent i < (resplen-2u) bounds checks all pass, allowing out-of-bounds reads into the response buffer. Similarly the 7C/82 tag searches iterate past the buffer. Fix: check resplen >= 2 before any arithmetic; return WP11_PIV_ERR_TRUNCATED (new code) if not.
